correctness.rationale: A shattered comparison graph cannot contain a cycle, since its cycle edges could be consistently asked to form an impossible directed cycle; a star is shattered by a pivot followed by low and high increasing subsequences, which avoids 321, proving VC=n−1. For the finite Ldim, the exact full binary-tree recursion on query answer fibers gives ranks (0,1,2,3,4,6,7) for n≤7 in an independently coded rank computation. At n=8, the actual frozen 511-query/512-leaf certificate was independently decoded and every unique leaf verified as 321-avoiding and realizing its exact 9-bit path. No depth 10 can exist since the smaller fiber of any first query has ≤429 candidates, below 2^9=512; hence Ldim=9. Direct sums of 8-block avoiders preserve avoidance and concatenate independent shattered trees to prove all s lower bounds. The finite certificate verifies its stated property, not an uncomputed exact Ldim at larger n.
